answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation is an EigenTrust matrix-factorization score with exponential temporal decay: without sustained honest service, its effective weight falls by half at every configured half-life. A freshly spawned sybil therefore has near-zero eigenvector centrality, no trusted inbound mass, and negligible reciprocity-weighted transitive support, so it cannot influence or pass consensus. Whether named raven, basalt, or sonnet, an identity must accumulate verifiable reciprocal interactions over time before gaining decisive weight.
